title: one hour, by the minute
caption:
one hour of work, audited minute by minute.

14 minutes of setup, npm install and coffee. 9 on the wrong branch.
11 doomscrolling "for a sec." 12 in a meeting about the task.
the actual work: 7 minutes. explaining why it took an hour: another 7.

how many minutes of your hour are actual work?

items: explaining why it took an hour
slide.kicker: billed as one hour. lived as seven minutes.
